title: Leadership Principles: a user's manual
source: Kindel leadership principles user's manual for Any Company. Reused from the classic set and edited where the wording differs.
howTo: Use this when you are applying a principle, studying one, reviewing work, or coaching someone who has taken it too far.
Under means they are not really doing it. Over means the principle has taken over the job. Just Right is the bar.
Score the situation against a row, then say under, just right, or over, and write the evidence. Rows come from kindel/principles.
Cross-refs look like {lp:ownership}. Render them as links. Agents treat them as hard links to that principle file.

crossRef.render: Replace the token with a link to that LP. Agents treat tokens as hard links.
